learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected twelve years and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Forty-thousand annual withdrawal at five percent showed 20.1 years. Twenty-five-thousand preset at five percent showed never runs out and flat balance. Zero-growth preset reset withdrawal to forty-thousand and showed 12.5 years. Restored forty-thousand at five percent, again20.1; all three traces retained.
observations.reveal: Corrected to twenty years, explained first-year twenty-five-thousand growth offsets withdrawal so balance shrinks fifteen-thousand, then growth falls as pot shrinks. Interest-matching withdrawal stays constant; steady return is made-up and real returns vary.
observations.visual: Actual dark 1257 by 936 screenshots inspected. Three retained balance traces show flat, curved depletion and zero-growth line with labeled endpoints. Model order grows then withdraws explicit. Current and prior trace labels cluster near zero but readable.
observations.previewIsolation: Preview banner said history and analytics are not saved.
observations.blinding: No source, builder notes or other reviews inspected.

interaction.reason: Three presets isolate growth contribution and interest-matching boundary.
interaction.evidence: 20.1,12.5 and never compared with retained traces.

payoff.reason: Reveal explains changing annual net draw rather than only final number.
payoff.evidence: First year shrinks fifteen-thousand, later shrinking earns less.

clarity.reason: Growth-before-withdrawal order and fixed-rate limitation are explicit.
clarity.evidence: Annual sequence label and real-returns caveat.

transfer.reason: General depletion principle stays in same savings scenario.

accessibility.evidence: Text durations and controls observed; screen reader, keyboard, contrast and reduced motion unaudited.

surprise.reason: Continuing earnings add years beyond simple division.

visualExplanation.reason: Retained flat and depletion traces show three regimes.
visualExplanation.evidence: Interest-matching flat line versus accelerating decline.

practicalValue.reason: Clarifies interaction between withdrawals and ongoing earnings.

depth.evidence: Lower balance earns less and depletion accelerates.

complexity.reason: Simple controls require compounding cash-flow reasoning.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Track growth on remaining balance followed by fixed withdrawal.
complexity.notationRepresentationBurden: Thousands of dollars, percentages and time-series curves.

whyCool: A shrinking pot keeps earning, so division misses the changing cash flows.
caveat: Fractional depletion-year convention is not explained despite end-of-year withdrawals; fixed returns exclude uncertainty, inflation and fees.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
